summary: Amazon Polly's free tier gives new AWS accounts 5 million characters per month on Standard voices and 1 million characters per month on Neural voices for the first 12 months after signup - roughly thousands of minutes of narration at zero cost.
claim_steps: Create an AWS account at aws.amazon.com (free tier applies automatically).
Convert text to speech using Standard or Neural voices within the monthly free character allowance.
Note the free window runs for the first 12 months from account creation.
